reuse_audit_conditions.description: Hashes verify exact historical matrices, not acquisition independence or absence of leakage. Before batch training, parent data audit must resolve substantive validity defects; C-PU raw record identities are unavailable and DIRG reuses bearing identities across conditions.

Reuse is conditional on preserving audited trainer semantics. Any changes to RNG order, selector, hard masks, loss normalization, BN restoration, ramp, source CE checkpointing or data hashes require a new compatibility assessment. Merely using seed0-4 does not establish pairing.

experiments/da_component_intervention/train_components.py hard asserts B=.1; B0 must use experiments/da_b_factorial/train_bfactor.py or an audited equivalent. Do not bulk-call the B=.1 runner for all8 cells.
Old partial suites predeclare only PU/CWRU10 seed0; DIRG and seeds1-4 need a new frozen protocol/config. Do not mutate original protocol files.

Reusable metrics/checkpoints do not supply complete selected indices, logits, batch IDs and trajectories for all160 anchors. Paired endpoint agreement is not full5000-step trajectory evidence. New diagnostic replay needs independent authorization/execution outside this audit.
32 old scope cases are LS-only, not LS+selected. They supply contextual controls only; none fills the80 planned selected_fixed/selected_domain_mean rows.
Existing main-table SoftMatch uses another backbone; no equivalent same-MSDGN mechanism row accepted in this320-row audit.
factor definitely missing=144; blocked/rejected=0; total440 minus accepted reuse=264. Evidence blocks are not automatically a mandate to retrain.

reuse_conditions_resolution: Data/literature gates; new core equivalence preflight; B0/DIRG supported by new runner; dense traces of new paired controls with explicit historical trajectory limit; 80 coverage and 40 soft rows newly trained.
schedule: All source training and checkpoint selection before any new target inference.

coverage.selected_domain_mean: (mean LS + mean selected US1 + mean selected US2)/3; empty-domain term is 0

coverage_forward: All conditions forward all 192 clean and perturbed samples before loss masking; inherited BN restoration unchanged.
coverage_limit: Masked samples may still influence shared BatchNorm; this is an explicit-loss coverage contrast.
soft_weight_label: MSDGN same-backbone USB SoftMatch weighting mechanism adaptation + B; not full SoftMatch reproduction
checkpoint_selection: minimum labeled-source validation cross-entropy at step 1 and every 250 through 5000
analysis: Paired deltas: average four targets within each seed, then mean, SD and descriptive 95% t interval over five optimization seeds. Retain per-target and negative effects; not 20 independent acquisitions.
low_source_validation: Report warning and retain run; do not retune or exclude.
completion: All prespecified valid entries, pairing checks, offline selection diagnostics and paired analysis, regardless of ranking. Conclusions may remain uncertain.
extensions: No automatic matched-count/class runs. Diagnose observed differences first and state remaining confounding before deciding any follow-up.

interpretation_limits.PU: Fixed supplied preprocessed matrix benchmark; user currently does not know origin. Physical class/condition/record provenance unresolved.
interpretation_limits.DIRG: Same bearings and rig across unseen speed/load conditions; not unseen-bearing generalization.
interpretation_limits.literature: Novelty not established; Ada-DRO full text unavailable; label/weight separation already exists in SoftMatch.

historical_timing_seconds.caveat: New trace and integrity checks add overhead; estimate from first completed new runs instead.
